launcher.release_notes:
cx-labs-launcher: 0.11.0 — audit events now carry lifetime, check_count, and a normalized AI-review status (#214)

Three enrichments to the audit stream so the CS-internal dashboards can
answer "how long did they have the task open?", "how many times did they
click Check?", and "did AI review actually run?" without DataPrime joins
or heuristics on dashboard filters.

**state.rs — per-(scenario, cluster) bookkeeping**
New ModuleInstallRecord { installed_at, context_hash, check_count }
stored in state.json under HashMap<String, _> keyed by
"{scenario_id}:{context_hash}". Keyed on the hash (not just id) so the
same scenario deployed on two clusters (Colima + Docker, or a cluster
destroyed and recreated under a new name) is tracked independently —
avoids the overwrite case the user flagged.

**commands.rs**
- deploy_scenario: on a successful apply, record_module_install stamps
  a fresh installed_at + zeroes check_count. Overwrites a prior entry
  for the same key, so a redeploy without uninstall still gets
  meaningful lifetime (time-since-this-deploy).
- verify_scenario: bump_module_check_count returns the new value; event
  carries `check_count` (null for pre-v0.11.0 installs where tracking
  wasn't started). AI verdict normalized to a stable enum via
  normalize_ai_review:
    status: "pass" | "fail" | "skipped" | "not_configured"
    verdict: original CLI text (reason when skipped, verdict when ran)
  Dashboards group by status instead of inferring from passed/skipped
  booleans + null.
- remove_scenario: take_module_install drops the entry and returns it;
  the event carries `lifetime_ms` and `check_count_total`. Taken
  BEFORE kubectl delete so a failing delete still clears the record
  (the trainee's intent is to remove it; a retry emits a honest
  no-lifetime event).
- remove_kind_cluster: drop_module_installs_for_context prunes every
  record on the destroyed cluster so no uninstall event is ever owed
  for scenarios that lived there.

Both the module and verify events now stamp `context.schema_version: 2`
so dashboards can filter on it to pick the right query shape.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
